description: Vite build optimizations: refine manualChunks to better isolate heavy libraries, enable build compression hints, and add modulepreload polyfill. Also split motion/react (framer-motion) into its own lazy chunk since it is used only in MovieDeckStack and MoviesTopControls, and split gsap into its own chunk. Add vite-plugin-compression or configure Rollup to produce gzip/brotli output for Netlify/Vercel. Tighten the chunk warning limit now that chunks are better split.
steps: 2. In vite.config.ts, update manualChunks to add dedicated chunks: 'motion-vendor' for 'node_modules/motion' and 'node_modules/framer-motion', 'animation-vendor' for 'node_modules/gsap'. Keep existing react-vendor, graphics-vendor (ogl), map-vendor (maplibre-gl), and vendor chunks. Move all remaining node_modules to vendor.
3. Add `modulePreload: { polyfill: true }` to the build.rollupOptions.output in vite.config.ts. This ensures modulepreload links in the HTML work cross-browser.
4. Add `cssCodeSplit: true` to vite.config.ts build options (it may default to true already - ensure it is explicit).

5. Add build.minify: 'esbuild' (Vite default, but make explicit) and build.target: 'es2020' to improve modern-browser tree-shaking. NOTE: Do NOT change anything that could break the existing API proxy or server configuration.

6. Run `npx vite build` from /projects/sandbox/electron to verify the build still succeeds and chunk sizes are sensible (map-vendor should be ~1MB, graphics-vendor ~300KB, motion-vendor ~200KB, animation-vendor ~150KB, react-vendor ~200KB, main chunk should be smaller than before).
7. Adjust chunkSizeWarningLimit if needed based on new chunk distribution (keep at 1100 or lower if new chunks are smaller).
acceptance_criteria: vite.config.ts manualChunks includes motion-vendor and animation-vendor chunks
verification: npx vite build from /projects/sandbox/electron - check for new motion-vendor and animation-vendor chunk files in dist/assets/
